name: Tattvakośa
description: Classical Sanskrit–English scholarly lexicon with 688 cited headwords from Amarakośa, Pāṇinīya Dhātupāṭha, Ekākṣara Mātṛkā, and Śrī Madhvācārya's Sarvamūla sūtras, plus 24 kHz Ninada v5.1 neural Sanskrit recitation.

tools.name: search_tattvakosha
tools.description: Search 688 classical Sanskrit headwords by Devanāgarī, IAST, ASCII phonetic, or English gloss.

query.description: Devanāgarī, IAST, ASCII Roman, or English search query

tools.name: get_sanskrit_entry
tools.description: Retrieve the complete scholarly entry, sūtra, padaccheda split, fourfold Ekākṣara registers, and grantha citation for an entry ID.

id.description: Headword ID (e.g. jiva, ekakshara-a, pramana, surya)

tools.name: pronounce_sanskrit
tools.description: Synthesize and play classical Sanskrit text in the browser at 24,000 Hz via Ninada v5.1 ONNX.
